name: PollinationPro
description: A browser-based platform for analysing plants, pollinators and their overlap with occurrence data: GBIF records and published interactions, record cleaning and taxonomic harmonisation, offline maps, probabilistic co-occurrence with a target-group universe, circular phenology, environmental niche overlap (PCA-env, Schoener's D, equivalency and similarity tests), potential distribution and plant–visitor mismatch, and interaction networks. Any crop or plant, any visitors. No installation, no third-party libraries, Spanish and English.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari)
